title: Family Group with Dog, 1940s Black & White Snapshot Photo
description: A mid-1940s black and white vintage snapshot showing a family group gathered outside in front of a wooden house porch with a plant trellis. Five women and a young girl are standing together outdoors in cool weather, dressed in tailored knee-length coats and outerwear characteristic of the WWII and immediate post-war period. In front, the young girl grins while holding a small terrier-type dog on a leash.
